parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence: the impersonation law targeting gender-diverse people was repealed in 2013, and an embedded third-gender tradition plus official recognition (chiefly titles, UPR statements, Pride Week 2026) document social acceptance of gender diversity. The sodomy sections remain on the books but are documented as unenforced with no recorded prosecutions — a secondary, tangential factor under rule 2 given the tolerant society; it touches a trans visitor only via a locally-classed same-sex relationship. A sentencing-stage gender-identity aggravator and a conversion-therapy ban are genuine (if partial) protections. Deductions: no documented service-refusal remedy case, border/document exposure wholly unsourced (open question, not exposure), custody and ward practice undocumented, and the hostility-laden government rhetoric on LGBTQ issues. No violence data, no targeting, no universal-exposure measure. Reduced risk, below acceptance-plus-working-protection tiers.
